name: Donor Card A-
description:
Can take blood from: O-, A-
Can give blood to: A-, A+, AB-, AB+

name: Donor Card A+
description:
Can take blood from: O-, O+, A-, A+
Can give blood to: A+, AB+

name: Donor Card AB-
description:
Can take blood from: O-, A-, B-, AB-
Can give blood to: AB-, AB+

name: Donor Card AB+
description:
Can take blood from: all of them
Can give blood to: AB+

name: Adrenaline
description: A naturally occurring hormone. For a short amount of time, it will raise the patient's Blood Pressure, increase Melee Damage, halve Fibrillation Rate, prevent Pain, and prevent the limb locking and slowdowns from Fractures and Dislocations. Upon use, it will also cure Cardiac Arrest, remove Stun, and briefly reduce incoming Stuns.
usage: Use on patient. Consumed. No skill check.

skill.notes: No skill check.

summary: Adrenaline: restarts a stopped heart (leaves Irregular Heartbeat that then needs a Manual Defibrillator/AED) and gives an adrenaline boost. Also halves the skill needed to reset dislocations.

name: Hemostat
description: A tool used to Clamp Blood Vessels during surgery. The second step in most surgical operations, done after Surgical Incisions.
usage: Use on a limb with Surgery Incision >=99 and no Clamped Bleeding; analgesia or unconscious; not in stasis. Not consumed.

skill.notes: No skill check; strength scales with skill.

onFailure: N/a (but the incision must have reached 99 - low skill incisions grow over time).
summary: Hemostat: second surgery step - clamps bleeding vessels after the incision.

name: Skin Retractors
description: A tool used to Retract Skin during surgery. Retracting the skin is the third step in most surgical operations, but will cause Traumatic Shock if the patient is conscious and not laying on a bed or close to a Surgery Table or hospital bed. Used after Hemostat Clamping. On failure, causes Internal Damage.
usage: Use on a limb with Clamped Bleeding >=99 and no Retracted Skin; analgesia or unconscious; not in stasis. Not consumed.

skill.notes: Surgery skill = medical skill unless Neurotrauma Surgery Plus (NTSP) is enabled, then max(surgery, medical/4). Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Skin retractors: third surgery step - opens the wound. Most internal procedures (organs, drills, saws, sutures for arteries) need Retracted Skin.

name: Scalpel
description: A tool used to make Surgical Incisions during surgery. Incisions are the first step in all surgical operations, but will cause Blood Loss unless the Hemostat is used afterwards. Additionally, incisions can only be performed if the patient does not feel pain, and patients who become pain-aware during surgery will gain Traumatic Shock. On failure, causes Bleeding and Lacerations.
usage: Use on a limb with no existing Surgery Incision; patient must have analgesia (>=1) or be unconscious; not in stasis. Not consumed.

skill.notes: Surgery skill = medical skill unless Neurotrauma Surgery Plus (NTSP) is enabled, then max(surgery, medical/4). Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Scalpel: first step of every surgery - makes the incision. Remove casts/bandages automatically. Patient must be numbed (analgesia) or unconscious.

name: Automated External Defibrillator
description: The AED uses battery power for a small chance to cure Cardiac Arrest and is guaranteed to reset Fibrillation. For curing Cardiac Arrest, use the Manual Defibrillator instead if medical skill is above 80.
usage: Use on patient; requires a charged battery. 5 s cooldown. Only shocks if patient has Increased Heartrate >=5, Irregular Heartbeat >=1 or Cardiac Arrest; otherwise plays a 'no shock' sound. Drains battery 20 (10 fulgurium). Effect after 3.2 s.

skill.notes: Cardiac-arrest fix chance = clamp(medical/200, 20%, 40%).

summary: Automatic Manual Defibrillator: reliably fixes Irregular Heartbeat/tachycardia regardless of skill and has a 20-40% chance per shock to restart a stopped heart. Safe to use - it won't shock a normal rhythm.

name: Alien Blood
description: Blood extracted from a Europan lifeform. It is incompatible with human blood.
usage: Use on patient. Consumed.

skill.notes: Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Alien blood is harmful in Neurotrauma: it causes massive hemotransfusion shock, psychosis and actually adds Blood Loss. Do not use as a transfusion.

name: Analgesic Tank
description: A tank of analgesics which can be installed on a Surgery Table to provide the patient-laying-down enough Analgesia to perform surgery. It can also be used in an Ambubag, but causes extra Addiction.

name: Broad-Spectrum Antibiotics
description: An antibiotic that acts against a wide range bacteria, making it an effective treatment for Sepsis and to a lesser extent, Husk Infection. However, its broad nature causes Organ Damage. Used as an ingredient in multiple medical compounds. On failure, it is less effective.
usage: Use on patient. Consumed.

skill.notes: RequiredSkill.

summary: Antibiotics: apply Antibiotics, which fights sepsis and infections (per affliction code), and give husk infection resistance.

name: Bandage
description:
Basic bandages, useful in the treatment of Bleeding, and increases the natural healing of minor Burns and wounds. Additionally, being bandaged stabilizes Fractures and Dislocations. Effects which increase the speed of natural healing do not work if the injury is beyond its natural healing threshold. On failure, it is less effective. Stabilization prevents: 
- Arm fractures from reaching 100% 
- Neck fractures from causing spinal injury and internal damage 
- Rib fractures from causing pneumothorax 
- Dislocations from causing internal damage 
- Arm dislocations from locking 
- And restores the function of dislocated legs
usage: Use on any limb. Consumed. Replaces a dirty bandage.

skill.notes: Talent 'medicalexpertise' adds the same bonus again. Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Bandage: slows bleeding on a limb and marks it bandaged (needed before applying a plaster cast). Replace dirty bandages to avoid infection.

name: Plastiseal
description: A synthetic skin with hemostatic properties able to effectively seal bleeds, and is a good treatment against minor Burns while increasing the natural healing of Wounds. Additionally, stabilizes Fractures and Dislocations. Finally, they can be used to treat Third-degree Burns when used after Skin Retraction. On failure, it is less effective.

treatsDetail.amount: Up to -200 if limb has Retracted Skin; else -12/-24 if burn > 50

usage: Use on any limb. Consumed. On a surgically opened limb (Retracted Skin) it heals burns.

skill.notes: Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Plastiseal: a stronger bandage. Applied on an opened (retracted) limb it fully treats severe burns (skin grafting); otherwise it helps only with burns above 50.

name: Antibiotic Glue
description: An antibiotic glue with hemostatic properties. Seals Bleeding wounds almost immediately and prevents them from getting Infected. Also effective against Burns. On failure, it may cause mobile clots in the bloodstream.

causesDetail.when: On failure, if the limb is bleeding > 0.1

usage: Use on a limb. Consumed.

skill.notes: RequiredSkill.

onFailure: Weaker healing; if the limb is bleeding it can trigger a heart attack.
summary: Antibiotic glue: strong bleeding/burn/infection treatment for a limb, but a failed application on a bleeding wound causes a heart attack.

name: Saline
description: A sodium chloride infusion used to increase Blood Pressure, and additionally causes Acidosis. On failure, it has less duration.
usage: Use on patient. Consumed. Also used as the refill for the antiseptic sprayer (cavity irrigation).

skill.notes: Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Saline IV: applies Saline (volume expander raising blood volume/pressure per affliction code). Cheap first response for blood loss; not a blood replacement.

name: Blood Pack O-
description: A blood pack that can be used on any patient.

treatsDetail.notes: Multiplied toward 0 by up to 10% depending on Blood Loss/30

causesDetail.when: Sometimes. Pack was drawn from a septic donor (tag 'sepsis')
Sometimes. Pack tagged acid:N (donor was acidotic)

usage: Use on patient (any limb). Consumed; gives the user an Empty Blood Pack. Compatibility is checked against the patient's blood type (antigens A, B, Rh; Blood Pack O- is O-negative = universal donor).

skill.notes: No skill check for the transfusion itself; medical XP only if patient Blood Loss > 100.

onFailure: Incompatible blood still restores 20 Blood Loss but causes Hemotransfusion Shock scaled by the patient's immunity.
summary: O-negative blood pack: universal donor, safe for anyone. Restores blood volume (-30 Blood Loss) and raises blood pressure. Giving the wrong type triggers hemotransfusion shock unless the patient's immunity is low (e.g. immunosuppressed).

name: Morphine
description: A powerful Opioid Analgesic, but overuse will cause Addiction and Overdose. On failure, it is less effective and there is a greater risk of Addiction and Overdose.
usage: Use on patient. Consumed.

skill.notes: RequiredSkill for use (fabrication needs 18).

summary: Morphine: the standard painkiller. Gives analgesia, which is needed for (or makes easier) surgery and joint resetting. Watch overdose and addiction with repeated doses.

name: Fentanyl
description: A very potent Opioid Analgesic, but overuse will cause Addiction and Overdose. Analgesia will not only prevent pain, but will also reduce damage taken and increase stun resistance. On failure, it is less effective and there is a greater risk of addiction and overdose.
usage: Use on patient. Consumed.

skill.notes: RequiredSkill for use.

summary: Fentanyl: very strong, fast painkiller. High overdose risk - have naloxone ready. Needs 72 medical to use safely.

name: Naloxone
description: An opioid antagonist for the treatment of opiate Withdrawal and Overdose. Additionally, it will reduce Analgesia. On failure, it is less effective and may cause a short Coma.
usage: Use on patient. Consumed.

skill.notes: RequiredSkill for use.

onFailure: Half strength and causes coma build-up.
summary: Naloxone: reverses opioid overdose (and removes opioid pain relief). Use on someone overdosing on morphine/fentanyl.

name: Anaparalyzant
description: A cure for Paralysis and prematurely ends Anesthesia. Excessive use may cause Psychosis. On failure, it is less effective and causes more Psychosis.
usage: Use on patient. Consumed.

skill.notes: Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

onFailure: Slow, weaker effect spread over 60 s with much more psychosis.
summary: Anaparalyzant: wakes a patient from anesthesia and grants paralysis resistance. Low skill makes it slow and causes a lot of psychosis.

name: Haloperidol
description: A strong antipsychotic drug, effective against treatment of Alcohol Withdrawal. On failure, it is less effective.
usage: Use on patient. Consumed.

skill.notes: RequiredSkill.

onFailure: Only a quarter of the effect.
summary: Haloperidol: clears psychosis, hallucinations and alcohol withdrawal.

name: Antiseptic
description: Used by the Antiseptic Sprayer, it is effective against treating Infected Wounds.
usage: Loaded into the antiseptic sprayer (not applied directly by C#).
summary: Antiseptic refill for the antiseptic sprayer; each spray uses 10% of it.

name: Antiseptic Sprayer
description: Applies Antiseptic to combat Infected Wounds.

treatsDetail.notes: Saline mode applies Cleaning cavity which cleans the cavity (affliction code)

usage: Use on a limb; 2 s cooldown; needs a loaded antiseptic or saline. Not in stasis. Saline mode: Torso with Infected Stomach Cavity and Retracted Skin - consumes the saline. Antiseptic mode: any limb, uses 10 antiseptic condition.

skill.notes: No pass/fail; Cleaning cavity strength = max(surgery skill/2, 10). lists medical 40.

summary: Antiseptic sprayer: with antiseptic it disinfects wounds; loaded with saline it irrigates an infected abdominal cavity during open torso surgery.

name: Non-working Arm
description:
This arm has become unusable! 
This could be because of a Dislocation, a Fracture or an Amputation.

name: AutoPulse
description: A machine that occupies a patient's Outerwear slot. Over time, cures Cardiac Arrest and Fibrillation. Wearing the AutoPulse will additionally increase Blood Pressure, which may be useful in an emergency. Remember to take it off when no longer needed! It can also be equipped through the Health UI and unequipped by using a Wrench on the torso.
usage: Use on a patient not in water: placed into their outerwear slot (swaps out their current outerwear into your inventory).

skill.notes: No skill check.

summary: AutoPulse: strap it onto a patient's outerwear slot to give automatic CPR (AutoPulse CPR) while they are alive. Can't be applied underwater.

name: Donor Card B-
description:
Can take blood from: O-, B-
Can give blood to: B-, B+, AB-, AB+

name: Donor Card B+
description:
Can take blood from: O-, O+, B-, B+
Can give blood to: B+, AB+

name: Blue Shark
description: A cute plushie that will slightly reduce Psychosis each time a patient is hit with it.
usage: Use on anyone. Not consumed.
summary: Blue shark plushie: hug it to reduce psychosis slightly. Unlimited uses.

name: Hematology Analyzer
description: A tool that displays a patient's blood type and immunity. Additionally shows if a patient has Blood Loss, Sepsis, Acidosis, Alkalosis or drugs in the bloodstream. If a blank donor card is inserted, it will print the patient's bloodtype onto their ID card. If a blood pack is inserted, any existing Sepsis, Acidosis or Alkalosis will be shown. The analyzer requires a bit of blood to print donor cards.
usage: Use on a patient (any limb) with item condition >= 50. Not consumed. If a Blank Donor Card (Blank Donor Card) or a donor card is loaded, it is consumed and a blood-type card is placed in the patient's ID card slot (or in the analyzer).

skill.notes: Only affects how much blood is drawn. Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

onFailure: Draws more blood (+3 Blood Loss instead of +1).
summary: Hematology Analyzer: prints the patient's blood type and blood-related readings (sepsis, immunity, acidosis/alkalosis, Blood Loss, Blood Pressure and drug levels like Saline, Adrenaline, Antibiotics, Opioids...). Load a blank donor card to produce a blood-type card. Each scan takes a little blood.

name: Blank Donor Card
description: An empty donor card used by the hematology analyzer to imprint a patient's blood type.

name: Blood Pack A-
description: Administerable to: A-, A+, AB-, AB+

treatsDetail.notes: Multiplied toward 0 by up to 10% depending on Blood Loss/30

causesDetail.when: Sometimes. Pack was drawn from a septic donor (tag 'sepsis')
Sometimes. Pack tagged acid:N (donor was acidotic)

usage: Use on patient (any limb). Consumed; gives the user an Empty Blood Pack. Compatibility is checked against the patient's blood type (antigens A, B, Rh; Blood Pack O- is O-negative = universal donor).

skill.notes: No skill check for the transfusion itself; medical XP only if patient Blood Loss > 100.

onFailure: Incompatible blood still restores 20 Blood Loss but causes Hemotransfusion Shock scaled by the patient's immunity.
summary: Blood pack of a specific type; only safe for compatible recipients. Restores blood volume (-30 Blood Loss) and raises blood pressure. Giving the wrong type triggers hemotransfusion shock unless the patient's immunity is low (e.g. immunosuppressed).

name: Body Bag
description: A bag that occupies a patient or corpse's Outerwear slot. Allows them to be dragged at full speed, but a living person cannot breathe through the bag, causing Oxygen Low.
usage: Worn (outerwear).
summary: Body bag for corpses; wrench can remove it.

name: Brain Transplant
description: A human brain. To transplant an organ, the old one must be removed and the new one placed in. The brain will decay even if refrigrated and is extremely fragile, and it is also tasty treat for pets.

causesDetail.when: Sometimes. While lying out of a container

usage: Use on the Head with Retracted Skin and Brain Removed. Consumed. On a server, the player whose brain it is (name stored in item description) takes control of the new body.

skill.notes: Fail reduces effective quality by 40. Surgery skill = medical skill unless Neurotrauma Surgery Plus (NTSP) is enabled, then max(surgery, medical/4). Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

onFailure: Brain works as if 40 points more damaged (more neurotrauma left).
summary: Puts a harvested brain into a body whose brain was removed; in multiplayer it moves that player into the new body. Needs a 100 surgery skill to guarantee full quality.

usage: Lie/sleep in it (OnActive).
summary: Resting in a bed slowly cures nausea, addictions/withdrawal, drunkenness and concussion.

usage: Lie/sleep in it (OnActive).
summary: Resting in a bed slowly cures nausea, addictions/withdrawal, drunkenness and concussion.

name: Ambu Bag
description: The Ambu Bag will treat Oxygen Low when provided with an oxygen tank and additionally treats Respiratory Arrest if provided with an oxygenite tank.
usage: Use on a (non-dead) patient; works by contained tank. Has a reload/condition cooldown (condition -100 per use, restored when broken).

skill.notes: Only; no skill check.

summary: Bag valve mask: manually ventilates a patient who isn't breathing. Load an oxygen tank for strong effect (oxygenite also cures respiratory arrest); an analgesic tank gives opioid pain relief. Don't load fuel or paint.

name: Captain's Pipe
description: For calming the nerves when the sea is stormy. It is hard on the lungs, though.
usage: Secondary use (smoke) by the holder.
summary: Captain's pipe: smoking calms psychosis slightly at the cost of a tiny bit of lung damage.

name: Cigar
description: A submariner's life is mentally taxing, but perhaps this exquisitely crafted cigar can help you soothe your nerves a bit. It is hard on the lungs, though.
usage: Secondary use (smoke) by the holder.
summary: Cigar: like the pipe, reduces psychosis/hallucinations with slight lung damage.

name: Manual Defibrillator
description: A tool that uses battery power to cure Cardiac Arrest or reset Fibrillation. For curing Cardiac Arrest, use the AED instead if medical skill is below 80. For curing Fibrillation, use the AED instead if medical skill is below 100. On failure, causes Cardiac Arrest.
usage: Use on patient; requires a charged battery inside. 5 s cooldown. Each shock drains battery 20 (10 for fulgurium cell). Effect lands after 2 s.

skill.notes: Chance-based on raw medical skill: rhythm fix chance (skill/100)^2, cardiac arrest fix chance (skill/100)^4.

onFailure: Shock does nothing beyond stun (an arrestFailChance is computed but unused).
summary: Manual Defibrillator: shocks Irregular Heartbeat/tachycardia back to normal; very skill-dependent (at 50 medical only 25% for rhythm and ~6% for cardiac arrest). Shocks even when not needed.

name: Deusizine
description: A stimulant that increases muscular endurance and can be used in the treatment of Internal Damage, Oxygen Deprivation, and Blood Loss. On failure, it is less effective.
usage: Use on patient. Consumed.

skill.notes: RequiredSkill.

summary: Deusizine: powerful all-round healing over 20 s (organs, internal damage, blood loss, oxygen). Expensive.

name: Dialysis Filter
description: A filter which can be installed on a Surgery Table to reduce Alkalosis and Acidosis for the patient laying-down. Reducing the afflictions provides a minor risk of contracting Sepsis.

name: Diving Knife
description: Stabs, pokes, cuts and slashes. Also can be used to remove old Bandages. On failure, causes Lacerations and Bleeding.
usage: Use on a limb (patient not in stasis). Not consumed.

skill.notes: Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Diving knife can cut off bandages and tourniquets like trauma shears, but needs more skill (30) and cannot remove plaster casts.

name: Drainage
description: Treats Pneumothorax and Cardiac Tamponade by draining air and fluid respectively. Can be used after Skin Retraction.

treatsDetail.notes: Requires Torso Retracted Skin >= 95; disabled by config NT_OpenCloseTamponade

usage: Use on patient (Torso open). Consumed only if it treated something. Blocked by stasis. lists medical 30 but C# does no skill check.

skill.notes: No skill check in C#; RequiredSkill medical 30 (hint).

summary: Chest drain: the definitive fix for pneumothorax and Cardiac Tamponade (and removes the decompression needle) during open-chest surgery.

name: Empty Blood Pack
description: An empty blood pack for the drawing of blood. The drawn blood will retain a small amount of the donor's Acidosis, Alkalosis or Sepsis - if they had any. It is safe to draw a single pack of blood from a patient, provided that they are healthy. On failure, it will draw a potentially-lethal amount of blood.
usage: Use on a human patient (any limb) whose Blood Loss is below 31. Consumed; user receives a filled blood pack of the donor's blood type (Blood Pack O- for O-negative) that carries the donor's acidosis/alkalosis/sepsis as tags.

skill.notes: Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

onFailure: Draws 40 Blood Loss instead of 30 from the donor.
summary: Draws blood from a healthy donor to make a blood pack. Will not work if the donor already has 31+ Blood Loss. Blood from a septic or acidotic donor passes those problems on.

name: Endovascular Balloon
description: A balloon inserted into a ruptured aorta. This will prevent Blood Loss caused by the rupture, but the clog will cause Gangrene over time. It can be installed after a Scalpel Incision.
usage: Use on the Torso with Surgery Incision (>=1) when the patient has Aortic Rupture; not in stasis. Consumed on success.

skill.notes: No skill check.

summary: Endovascular balloon: temporarily seals a ruptured aorta via an incision (only needs the scalpel step), stopping internal bleeding. Follow with a medical stent.

name: Gel Coolant Pack
description: A package of cold gel that will greatly increase the natural healing of Blunt Force Trauma and treats Internal Bleeding over time. It is ineffective against other types of injuries and will worsen Infections. Effects which increase natural healing speed will not work if the injury is beyond its natural healing threshold. Can be used up to thrice, and will lose effectiveness if not refrigerated. When refrigerated, its condition will regenerate over time. On failure, its chilling duration is decreased.
usage: Use on any limb when item condition >= 25. Not consumed: loses 35 condition per use; slowly drains outside a refrigerated container and recharges (+17.5 per 5 s) inside one.

skill.notes: Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Gel ice pack: applies Chilled to a limb (cooling, used for swelling/burn/pain management per affliction code). Reusable; recharge it in a refrigerated container.

name: Gypsum
description: A powder that can be formed into a Plaster Cast. It is used to encase Limb Fractures, allowing them to heal. Used after Bandaging the limb. On failure, it is consumed without forming a cast.
usage: Use on a bandaged arm/leg that is not already in a cast, has no Surgery Incision, and patient not in stasis. Consumed even if the skill check fails.

skill.notes: Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

onFailure: Item is wasted, no cast applied.
summary: Plaster cast for broken arms/legs: bandage the limb first, then apply. The cast heals the fracture over time. New fractures (config) remove casts.

usage: Worn on the hands.
summary: Handcuffs lock the wearer's hands (lockedhands).

name: Amputated Head
description: An amputated head in a bag which will slowly decay unless refrigerated. The bones are rich in Calcium and are a tasty treat for pets. No, you can't transplant it, don't think about it.

name: Head Remains
description: The remains of a human head that was blown off. The face is mangled and unrecognizable, and it will slowly decay unless refrigerated. The bones are rich in Calcium and are a tasty treat for pets. No, you can't transplant it, don't think about it.

name: Health Scanner
description: A tool that uses battery power to display afflictions. It can be aimed at a person for a full-body scan, or administered in the Health UI to show afflictions on a specific body part. Using the scanner causes a minor amount of Radiation Sickness. Will not display Blood Type, Sepsis, Immunity, Acidosis, Alkalosis, or Drugs; these afflictions require a Hematology Analyzer.
usage: Use on a limb; needs a charged battery (drains 5 per scan). Not consumed. Readout after 2 s for the selected limb only.

skill.notes: No skill check.

summary: Health scanner: lists every affliction on the scanned limb with strengths, color-coded. Each scan gives a little radiation sickness to you and the patient.

name: Heart Transplant
description: A human heart. To transplant an organ, the old one must be removed and the new one placed in. Organs decay quickly if not refrigerated or in a human, and are a tasty treat for pets.

treatsDetail.amount: -item condition (removed organ) or set to 100 - condition (swap)

causesDetail.amount: -(condition/5) on removed organ, or +((100-old damage)-condition)/5 on swap

causesDetail.when: On swap (heart must be restarted, e.g. Manual Defibrillator)
Sometimes. Organ rejection roll (chance (immunity-10)/150 x talent multiplier) when config NT_organRejection is on

usage: Use on the Torso with Retracted Skin (>=99) after the old heart was cut out (Heart Removed) or freed with the organ scalpel (Replacing Heart). Consumed when it replaces a removed organ; on a swap the patient's old organ is returned as an item if it was <90% damaged.

skill.notes: Failing reduces effective organ quality by 40 (workcondition = item condition - 40). Surgery skill = medical skill unless Neurotrauma Surgery Plus (NTSP) is enabled, then max(surgery, medical/4). Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

onFailure: Low skill makes the new organ work as if 40% more damaged.
summary: Transplants a new heart. Open the torso, use the heart organ scalpel, then apply. Keep immunity low (Azathioprine) to avoid rejection; organ quality is the item condition, which rots outside refrigeration.

name: Hyperzine
description: An extremely potent muscle stimulant for those moments when you gotta go fast. Boosts muscular strength, endurance, and speed, and reduces stun susceptibility. It is addictive and causes a small amount of Neurotrauma. On failure, it is more addictive and causes more brain damage.
usage: Use on patient. Consumed.

skill.notes: RequiredSkill.

summary: Hyperzine: long speed and strength boost with mild healing; slowly damages the brain and causes psychosis.

name: Azathioprine
description: An immunosuppressant that will reduce a patient's Immunity. This is useful to prevent Organ Rejection or to administer incompatible blood types without triggering an immune response. However, a lower immunity will make the patient more susceptible to Sepsis. If a patient is given an organ transplant but it immediately fails, it has been rejected by the immune system. On failure, causes Sepsis.

treatsDetail.notes: Applies Immunosuppressants which lowers immunity (effect defined in affliction code, not here)

usage: Use on patient; pills. Consumed.

skill.notes: Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

onFailure: Weaker dose and 50% chance of sepsis.
summary: Azathioprine: suppresses the immune system. Use before/after organ transplants to reduce rejection, or before giving incompatible blood to reduce hemotransfusion shock.

name: Kidney Transplant
description: A human kidney. To transplant an organ, the old one must be removed and the new one placed in. Organs decay quickly if not refrigerated or in a human, and are a tasty treat for pets.
usage: Use on the Torso with Retracted Skin (>=99) and Kidneys Removed or Replacing Kidneys. Always consumed (also when rejected).

skill.notes: Fail reduces effective quality by 40. Surgery skill = medical skill unless Neurotrauma Surgery Plus (NTSP) is enabled, then max(surgery, medical/4). Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Replaces a kidney (kidneys count as two halves of Kidney Damage). If the patient's kidneys were under 45% damaged, a kidney item is returned. Rejection (config) destroys the transplant before it does anything.

name: Left Arm
description: A severed left arm. Can be surgically reattached after Sawing Bones. Severed limbs will slowly decay unless refrigerated, though the condition of a limb does not matter for transplanting purposes. The bones are rich in Calcium and are a tasty treat for pets.
usage: Use on the matching left arm stump that has Bones Sawed (>=99) from a surgical saw. Consumed.

skill.notes: No skill check.

onFailure: No failure state; does nothing if limb type mismatches or Bones Sawed missing.
summary: Reattaches a left arm. Saw the stump first (Bones Sawed) so the limb can be attached, then apply the limb.

name: Left Arm Bionic Prosthesis
description: A bionic left arm. Can be used to treat amputation, transforming into a biological arm. Can be attached after Sawing Bones.
usage: Use on the matching left arm stump that has Bones Sawed (>=99) from a surgical saw. Consumed.

skill.notes: No skill check.

onFailure: No failure state; does nothing if limb type mismatches or Bones Sawed missing.
summary: Reattaches a left arm (bionic). Saw the stump first (Bones Sawed) so the limb can be attached, then apply the limb.

name: Liquid Oxygenite
description: A volatile syringe of oxygenite that can be injected, forcefully oxygenating the blood for a short period of time. However, its toxicity causes slight Organ Damage. On failure, oxygenation is momentary and organs are further harmed. Hypoxemia damages the brain and organs, and is the main cause of death resulting from combat injuries.
usage: Use on patient. Consumed.

skill.notes: RequiredSkill.

onFailure: Far less oxygenation and more organ damage.
summary: Liquid oxygenite: rapidly fixes low blood oxygen (hypoxemia) at the cost of small damage to all organs.

NOTE: liver code applies -workcondition twice when the liver was removed (damage 100), and on a swap with old damage >=90 the transplant item is not removed (looks like a bug; unverified in game).

name: Mannitol
description: A sugar alcohol used to treat a significant amount of Neurotrauma and halve its rate of increase. However, it will not work unless the patient has over 70% Blood Pressure and oxygenated blood. Additionally, it will cause Heart- and Kidney Damage. On failure, it is less effective and will cause more Heart- and Kidney Damage.

causesDetail.when: When fired from a syringe gun (OnImpact)

usage: Use on patient. Consumed.

skill.notes: Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

onFailure: Weaker Mannitol and double organ/heart/kidney damage.
summary: Osmotic diuretic: applies Mannitol (used against brain swelling/neurotrauma in affliction code) but always costs some heart, kidney and organ damage. Needs high medical skill.

name: Medical Starter Crate
description: Once obtained, this crate will spawn first-aid and surgical necessities.

name: Medical Stent
description: A stent that can be inserted into the aorta to repair a rupture. It must be used after the Endovascular Balloon.
usage: Use on the Torso; works only when Ballooned Aorta present; not in stasis. ALWAYS consumed, even if nothing happens.

skill.notes: No skill check.

onFailure: N/a (wasted if no balloon in place).
summary: Medical stent: permanently repairs the aortic rupture after the endovascular balloon. Don't use it without the balloon - it's wasted.

name: Medical Container
description: Can store medicine and medical instruments

name: Methamphetamine
description: A potent nervous system stimulant, temporarily boosting the user's muscular speed. However, it is addictive, slightly damages Organs, and will cause some Neurotrauma. On failure, it is less effective, more addicting, and will cause increased damage.
usage: Use on patient. Consumed.

skill.notes: RequiredSkill.

summary: Methamphetamine: speed boost and stun removal, but damages brain and organs and causes psychosis/addiction.

name: Multipurpose Scalpel
description: Novelty scalpel. Disabled and needs activation. In the practitioner's hands, a button pad can be utilised to activate the scalpel and switch between between operations: making incisions, extracting organs, removing bandages, or doing malpractice.
usage: Mode chosen via item hooks: 'incision' = acts as Scalpel; 'bandage' = acts as trauma shears if anything cuttable is on the limb, otherwise malpractice damage; 'speedflex' = acts as an organ scalpel chosen by the limb clicked (head=brain, left arm=kidneys, torso=liver, right arm=heart, left leg=lungs) applied to the torso. Not consumed.

skill.notes: Inherits the checks of the tool it imitates.

summary: Multiscalpel: one tool that switches between scalpel, shears and organ-scalpel modes. In bandage mode with nothing to cut it injures the patient. Speedflex on the head likely does nothing (brain scalpel receives the torso limb and returns) - unverified.

name: Needle
description: A specialized needle used to depressurize air and fluid buildup, as a first aid option for Pneumothorax and Cardiac Tamponade. If the patient does not already have Pneumothorax, it will cause one instead. On failure, causes Organ Damage and Bleeding.

causesDetail.when: On success if the patient had neither pneumothorax nor Cardiac Tamponade

usage: Use on the Torso while the chest is NOT open (no Retracted Skin). Blocked by stasis. Consumed on success.

skill.notes: Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

onFailure: Organ damage and bleeding; needle not used up.
summary: Decompression needle: emergency field treatment for pneumothorax/Cardiac Tamponade (Needle relieves it until drained in surgery). Using it on a healthy chest causes a pneumothorax.

name: Nitroglycerin
description: A highly unstable liquid that may explode when subjected to heat or physical shock. When administered to a patient, it will cause vasodilation and decrease Blood Pressure.
usage: Use on patient. Consumed. Also a throwable explosive if broken.

skill.notes: Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Nitroglycerin acts as a blood pressure lowering drug (Blood Pressure Reducers). Careful: it is still an explosive when thrown/damaged.

name: Wheelchair
description: A tool that occupies a patient's Outerwear slot. Allows utilizing arms for movement, allowing you to move better with damaged legs.
usage: Worn by the patient.
summary: Wheelchair: lets a patient with leg problems get around (onwheelchair affliction; movement handled elsewhere).

name: Donor Card O-
description:
Can take blood from: O-
Can give blood to: all of them

name: Donor Card O+
description:
Can take blood from: O-, O+
Can give blood to: O+, A+, B+, AB+

name: Antibiotic Ointment
description: An antiseptic gel that will aid against fighting Infected Wounds and relieve minor Burns. On failure, it is less effective.
usage: Use on any limb. Consumed.

skill.notes: Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Antibiotic Ointment: clears wound infection on a limb and soothes minor burns (under 50). Leaves the limb Antibiotic Ointment (protective).

usage: Lie/sleep in it (OnActive).
summary: Resting in a bed slowly cures nausea, addictions/withdrawal, drunkenness and concussion.

usage: Lie/sleep in it (OnActive).
summary: Resting in a bed slowly cures nausea, addictions/withdrawal, drunkenness and concussion.

usage: Lie/sleep in it (OnActive).
summary: Resting in a bed slowly cures nausea, addictions/withdrawal, drunkenness and concussion. The hospital bed also counts as a (minimal) safe surgery spot with ventilation.

usage: Lie/sleep in it (OnActive).
summary: Resting in a bed slowly cures nausea, addictions/withdrawal, drunkenness and concussion.

name: Surgery Table
description: A portable version of the hospital bed, intended to be installed on submarines. Like the hospital bed, it comes with Artificial Ventilation. Additionally, it has electrical pins installed that can output a person's vitals. Built-in are slots for placing an Analgesic Tank, one of the Filters and a Refrigerated Crate. To use the Analgesic Tank and Filters on an unconscious patient, they will have to be forced on the table.

treatsDetail.notes: +100 to nearby characters when not contained; welding fuel tank removes it

causesDetail.when: While Dialysis Filter/Toxin Filter is working

usage: Patient lying on the table (OnActive). Contained tanks/filters feed effects.
summary: Operating table: provides artificial ventilation and safe-surgery conditions; can hold an analgesic tank (keeps patient numbed), a Dialysis Filter (fixes acidosis/alkalosis) or a toxin filter (removes poisons), but filters add some sepsis.

name: Opium
description: A relatively mild Opioid Analgesic obtained from aquatic poppy. Most commonly used to manufacture Morphine and Fentanyl. On failure, it is less effective and there is a greater risk of Addiction and Overdose.
usage: Use on patient. Consumed (vanilla consumable).

skill.notes: OnSuccess/OnFailure (vanilla skill roll).

onFailure: Less analgesia, more addiction and overdose.
summary: Opium: weak, slow painkiller with relatively high addiction. Mixing with alcohol (drunk > 30) adds extra overdose.

name: Refrigerated Crate
description: A crate to store precious transplant-ready organs and limbs. Organs will decay quickly when left outside, while limbs will decay slower. Organs and limbs will regenerate when refrigerated - but only if the organ is above 90% condition or if the limb is above 95% condition.

name: OOrgan Procurement Scalpel: Brain
description: A specialized scalpel for the removal of the brain.
usage: Use on the Head with Retracted Skin; not in stasis. Not consumed. 1st use: frees the organ (Replacing Brain = 100, or Brain Removed = 100 if the organ is already 100% dead). 2nd use (swap state): removes the organ and gives it to you (placed in a held container if possible) when it was < 90% damaged.

skill.notes: Only the first (freeing) use rolls; Surgery skill = medical skill unless Neurotrauma Surgery Plus (NTSP) is enabled, then max(surgery, medical/4). Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Brain organ scalpel: frees then extracts the brain into a brain transplant item (in multiplayer the player's client is detached and attached to the item). Leaves the body brain-dead.

name: Organ Procurement Scalpel: Heart
description: A specialized scalpel for the removal of the heart.
usage: Use on the Torso with Retracted Skin; not in stasis. Not consumed. 1st use: frees the organ (Replacing Heart = 100, or Heart Removed = 100 if the organ is already 100% dead). 2nd use (swap state): removes the organ and gives it to you (placed in a held container if possible) when it was < 90% damaged.

skill.notes: Only the first (freeing) use rolls; Surgery skill = medical skill unless Neurotrauma Surgery Plus (NTSP) is enabled, then max(surgery, medical/4). Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Heart organ scalpel: frees, then extracts the heart. Extraction causes cardiac arrest.

name: Organ Procurement Scalpel: Kidneys
description: A specialized scalpel for the removal of kidneys.
usage: Use on the Torso with Retracted Skin; not in stasis. Not consumed. 1st use: frees the organ (Replacing Kidneys = 100, or Kidneys Removed = 100 if the organ is already 100% dead). 2nd use (swap state): removes the organ and gives it to you (placed in a held container if possible) when it was < 90% damaged.

skill.notes: Only the first (freeing) use rolls; Surgery skill = medical skill unless Neurotrauma Surgery Plus (NTSP) is enabled, then max(surgery, medical/4). Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Kidney organ scalpel: frees the kidneys; each further cut removes one kidney (first at <50% damage, second at <95%).

name: Organ Procurement Scalpel: Liver
description: A specialized scalpel for the removal of livers.
usage: Use on the Torso with Retracted Skin; not in stasis. Not consumed. 1st use: frees the organ (Replacing Liver = 100, or Liver Removed = 100 if the organ is already 100% dead). 2nd use (swap state): removes the organ and gives it to you (placed in a held container if possible) when it was < 90% damaged (extraction additionally requires a surgery skill check of 50, silently doing nothing on failure).

skill.notes: Only the first (freeing) use rolls; Surgery skill = medical skill unless Neurotrauma Surgery Plus (NTSP) is enabled, then max(surgery, medical/4). Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Liver organ scalpel: harvest or prepare the liver for replacement. Cut once to free it, then either apply a new liver transplant (swap) or cut again to extract it.

name: Organ Procurement Scalpel: Lungs
description: A specialized scalpel for the removal of the lungs.
usage: Use on the Torso with Retracted Skin; not in stasis. Not consumed. 1st use: frees the organ (Replacing Lungs = 100, or Lungs Removed = 100 if the organ is already 100% dead). 2nd use (swap state): removes the organ and gives it to you (placed in a held container if possible) when it was < 90% damaged.

skill.notes: Only the first (freeing) use rolls; Surgery skill = medical skill unless Neurotrauma Surgery Plus (NTSP) is enabled, then max(surgery, medical/4). Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Lung organ scalpel: frees, then extracts the lungs. Extraction puts the patient in respiratory arrest.

name: Refrigerated Container
description: A container to store precious transplant-ready organs and limbs. Organs will decay quickly when left outside, while limbs will decay slower. Organs and limbs will regenerate when refrigerated - but only if the organ is above 90% condition or if the limb is above 95% condition.

name: Osteosynthesis Implants
description: Titanium implants used to repair Fractures. They can be installed after Drilling Bones. In the event of total Bone Death, Osteosynthesis Surgery must be performed on all body parts. On failure, causes Bleeding and Internal Damage.
usage: Use on a limb with Drilled Bones (>=99); patient must have analgesia or be unconscious. Loses 1/NT_OsteoImplants_uses (default 4 uses) condition per success.

skill.notes: Surgery skill = medical skill unless Neurotrauma Surgery Plus (NTSP) is enabled, then max(surgery, medical/4). Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

onFailure: Bleeding and internal damage; bones not fixed.
summary: Bone plates/screws: instantly fix fractures on the drilled limb. Open the limb, drill the bone, then apply; then suture.

name: Sodium Nitroprusside
description: A medication used to lower Blood Pressure. On failure, it is less effective.

causesDetail.amount: +50 over 10 s (success) / +30 (failure) from C#; also applies +5/s or +3/s for 10 s

usage: Use on patient; pills. Consumed.

skill.notes: Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Sodium nitroprusside: lowers blood pressure (Blood Pressure Reducers). Possibly applied twice (C# and both define it) - unverified.

name: Propofol
description: A general Anesthetic. Its effects take place after some time, and will not last very long. Anesthesized patients are Unconscious and do not gain Traumatic Shock from surgical operations. Usage may come with a variety of non-lethal Side Effects.

causesDetail.amount: +1 (or +15 with talent), topped up to 15 if already >= 15

usage: Use on patient. Consumed. No skill check.

skill.notes: No skill check; talent ntsp_propofol raises gain to 15.

summary: General anaesthetic: puts the patient under (anesthesia) so surgery can be performed without them being awake. Reverse with Anaparalyzant.

name: Right Arm
description: A severed right arm. Can be surgically reattached after Sawing Bones. Severed limbs will slowly decay unless refrigerated, though the condition of a limb does not matter for transplanting purposes. The bones are rich in Calcium and are a tasty treat for pets.
usage: Use on the matching right arm stump that has Bones Sawed (>=99) from a surgical saw. Consumed.

skill.notes: No skill check.

onFailure: No failure state; does nothing if limb type mismatches or Bones Sawed missing.
summary: Reattaches a right arm. Saw the stump first (Bones Sawed) so the limb can be attached, then apply the limb.

description: A bionic right arm. Can be used to treat amputation, transforming into a biological arm. Can be attached after Sawing Bones.
usage: Use on the matching right arm stump that has Bones Sawed (>=99) from a surgical saw. Consumed.

onFailure: No failure state; does nothing if limb type mismatches or Bones Sawed missing.
summary: Reattaches a right arm (bionic). Saw the stump first (Bones Sawed) so the limb can be attached, then apply the limb.

name: Repair Pack
description: A makeshift multi-tool, capable of quickly correcting both mechanical and electrical problems. Like the Wrench, they can be used to fix Dislocations. On failure, results in a Fracture.
usage: Use on a dislocated limb. If the limb is not dislocated and the patient is conscious, it removes a stasis bag / body bag / AutoPulse from their outerwear into your inventory.

skill.notes: Lowered to 30 if patient has analgesia >=0.5 or Adrenaline >=0.5. Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

onFailure: Breaks the bone (fracture) instead of resetting it.
summary: Wrenches reset dislocated joints. Give painkillers or adrenaline first to halve the skill needed and avoid severe pain; failure fractures the limb.

name: Ringer's Solution
description: An isotonic solution used to increase Blood Pressure, and additionally causes Alkalosis. On failure, it has less duration.
usage: Use on patient. Consumed.

skill.notes: Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Ringer's solution IV: applies the Ringer's Solution drug effect (fluid/electrolyte replacement; exact effects are in affliction code).

name: Right Leg
description: A severed right leg. Can be surgically reattached after Sawing Bones. Severed limbs will slowly decay unless refrigerated, though the condition of a limb does not matter for transplanting purposes. The bones are rich in Calcium and are a tasty treat for pets.
usage: Use on the matching right leg stump that has Bones Sawed (>=99) from a surgical saw. Consumed.

skill.notes: No skill check.

onFailure: No failure state; does nothing if limb type mismatches or Bones Sawed missing.
summary: Reattaches a right leg. Saw the stump first (Bones Sawed) so the limb can be attached, then apply the limb.

name: Right Leg Bionic Prosthesis
description: A bionic right leg. Can be used to treat amputation, transforming into a biological arm. Can be attached after Sawing Bones.
usage: Use on the matching right leg stump that has Bones Sawed (>=99) from a surgical saw. Consumed.

skill.notes: No skill check.

onFailure: No failure state; does nothing if limb type mismatches or Bones Sawed missing.
summary: Reattaches a right leg (bionic). Saw the stump first (Bones Sawed) so the limb can be attached, then apply the limb.

name: Spinal Cord Implants
description: Titanium implants used to repair spinal cord injuries. They can be installed after Skin Retraction. However, the spinal cord will be injured again if the Neck Fracture is not repaired with Osteosynthesis Surgery. On failure, causes Bleeding and Internal Damage.
usage: Use on a limb with Retracted Skin (>=99) when the patient has Spinal Cord Injury; patient must have analgesia or be unconscious. Default 1 use (NT_SpinalImplants_uses).

skill.notes: Surgery skill = medical skill unless Neurotrauma Surgery Plus (NTSP) is enabled, then max(surgery, medical/4). Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Spinal cord implant: cures spinal cord injury (paralysis) in open surgery. Code accepts any retracted limb (presumably torso intended).

name: Stasis Bag
description: A bag that occupies a patient's Outerwear slot, protecting against pressure down to 7,000 meters. This will cause Cardiac Arrest, Respiratory Arrest, Unconsciousness, and prevent surgical operations, but will pause the progression of negative afflictions while worn. When worn, the bag deteriorates by 1% every four seconds.
usage: Worn by the patient (outerwear). Drains 0.25 condition while worn.
summary: Stasis bag: freezes the patient's condition (stasis) so they don't deteriorate; many surgical tools refuse to work on a patient in stasis. Provides oxygen. A wrench pulls it off.

name: Streptokinase
description: An enzyme that breaks down blood clots, useful in the treatment of Heart Attacks. However, it will increase the chance of getting Strokes if the user has more than 150% Blood Pressure. Additionally, it is used to treat Hemotransfusion Shock.
usage: Use on patient. Consumed. No skill check.

skill.notes: No skill check in code.

summary: Clot-buster: cures heart attack and hemotransfusion shock instantly. Do NOT give it to a stroke patient (worsens stroke and adds neurotrauma).

name: Surgery Kit
description:
A kit that contains all the basic surgical equipment a medic could need, with some extra space leftover for other items. 

Enables usage of all basic Neurotrauma tools in the Health Menu.

name: Surgical Saw
description: A tool used to Saw Bones. After Skin Retraction, bones can be sawed to remove existing limbs or add new ones. Replacing limbs is required if Gangrene exceeds 15%. On failure, causes Bleeding, Internal Damage, and Lacerations.
usage: Use on a non-torso limb with Retracted Skin >=99 and no Bones Sawed; analgesia or unconscious; not in stasis. Not consumed. On the torso success does nothing.

skill.notes: Surgery skill = medical skill unless Neurotrauma Surgery Plus (NTSP) is enabled, then max(surgery, medical/4). Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Surgical saw: saws through the bone. Suturing afterwards amputates the limb cleanly (surgical amputation); applying a limb item instead reattaches a limb.

name: Surgery Toolbox
description: Can store many small items that are used during surgery

name: Surgery Toolbox
description: Can store many small items that are used during surgery

name: Surgical Drill
description: A tool used to Drill Bones during surgery. After Skin Retraction, bones can be drilled to perform Osteosynthesis Surgery which can fix Fractures. On failure, causes Bleeding and Internal Damage.
usage: Use on a limb with Retracted Skin >=99 and no Drilled Bones; analgesia or unconscious; not in stasis. Not consumed.

skill.notes: Surgery skill = medical skill unless Neurotrauma Surgery Plus (NTSP) is enabled, then max(surgery, medical/4). Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Surgical drill: drills the bone so osteosynthesis implants can be fitted (fracture repair).

name: Suture
description: Biodegradeable sutures used to complete surgery. On use, ends surgical operations at any step. Additionally, they can be used to Suture Open Wounds closed, and reduce a significant amount of external Bleeding. On failure, causes Internal Damage.

treatsDetail.notes: Only if config NT_HardmodeAorticRupture and Retracted Skin >= 95

usage: Use on any limb. Consumed every use (condition -100), including on failure. Not blocked by stasis.

skill.notes: Surgery skill = medical skill unless Neurotrauma Surgery Plus (NTSP) is enabled, then max(surgery, medical/4). Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

onFailure: Adds 6 Internal Damage to the limb; nothing is closed.
summary: Sutures close wounds and finish every surgery: they heal cuts/gunshot wounds, close the incision, and - while the limb is retracted - repair arterial cuts, internal bleeding, strokes etc. Suturing a sawed limb amputates it.

name: Thiamine
description: Otherwise known as Vitamin B1. These pills will provide a slight boost to Organ Regeneration. On failure, it is less effective.
usage: Use on patient; pills. Consumed.

skill.notes: Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Thiamine (vitamin B1): applies Thiamine (protects the brain, e.g. against alcohol-related damage, per affliction code).

name: Tonic Liquid
description: A medical solution that's mildly effective as a treatment for Internal Damage, but is more commonly used to increase the duration of bloodstream and performance-enhancing drugs.
usage: Use on a patient together with medical treatments (OnUse on UseTarget).
summary: Tonic liquid: extends the duration of medical status effects (durationincrease).

name: Tourniquet
description: An item that prevents Blood Loss from Arterial Bleeding. It cannot be used for the Carotid Artery. A Tourniqueted limb will experience Gangrene over time, and it is removed during surgery. On failure, causes Blunt Force Trauma.

treatsDetail.notes: Tourniqueted stops bleeding on that limb (effect in affliction code)

usage: Use on a limb without a tourniquet already. Extremities: sets tourniqueted 100. Head: strangles. Torso: consumed with no effect. Consumed on success only.

skill.notes: Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

onFailure: Adds 6 blunt trauma to the limb and the tourniquet is not used up.
summary: Stops severe arm/leg bleeding (e.g. Arterial Bleeding) fast. Remove it later with trauma shears/diving knife or close properly in surgery; long tourniquet use harms the limb. Never put it on the head.

name: Toxin Filter
description: A filter which can be installed on a Surgery Table to treat Poisons for the patient laying-down. While it is slower than antidotes, it can treat all vanilla poisons. Treating poisons provides a minor risk of contracting Sepsis.

name: Trauma Shears
description: A tool used to remove Bandages or Plaster Casts. On failure, causes Bleeding and Lacerations.
usage: Use on a limb; not in stasis. Not consumed.

skill.notes: Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Trauma shears remove bandages, dirty bandages, tourniquets and plaster casts from a limb.

name: Tweezers
description: A small tool that allows for removing unwanted tissue. After Skin Retraction, Tweezers can be used to remove some Foreign Bodies or convert Blunt Force Trauma and Internal Damage into Suturable Lacerations. Foreign Bodies can also be removed through open Gunshot Wounds or Deep Tissue Injuries, but this will cause minor Traumatic Shock. On failure, causes Internal Damage.

causesDetail.when: No valid use case and patient awake
No valid use case and awake

usage: Use on a limb. Mode 'surgery' if analgesia/unconscious and Retracted Skin >=99; mode 'field' if limb has Gunshot Wound or Explosion Damage. Otherwise it just pinches. Not consumed; blocked by stasis.

skill.notes: Surgery skill = medical skill unless Neurotrauma Surgery Plus (NTSP) is enabled, then max(surgery, medical/4). Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

summary: Tweezers pull shrapnel/bullets (Foreign Body) out. Best done in open surgery, where they also mend internal damage; in the field via a gunshot/explosion wound they cause traumatic shock. Small chance to return scrap.

name: Wrench
description: Makes mechanical repairs possible. It is also used to fix Dislocations, which only requires half the skill to do if the patient does not feel pain. Failing to fix a Dislocation will result in a Fracture, however.
usage: Use on a dislocated limb. If the limb is not dislocated and the patient is conscious, it removes a stasis bag / body bag / AutoPulse from their outerwear into your inventory.

skill.notes: Lowered to 30 if patient has analgesia >=0.5 or Adrenaline >=0.5. Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

onFailure: Breaks the bone (fracture) instead of resetting it.
summary: Wrenches reset dislocated joints. Give painkillers or adrenaline first to halve the skill needed and avoid severe pain; failure fractures the limb.
